name: What is the typical process for replacing siding around an exterior door?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for replacing siding around an exterior door?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process generally involves carefully removing the existing siding and trim around the door opening. The underlying wall sheathing is inspected for any damage, and repairs are made if necessary. New flashing and weather-resistant barriers are installed to ensure a watertight seal. Finally, new siding panels are cut and installed to fit precisely around the door frame, along with appropriate trim and sealants. The goal is a seamless, weatherproof integration.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves removing old siding, inspecting for damage, installing new flashing and weather barriers, then fitting and sealing new siding and trim around the door.
